_comment: Replay baselines (Self-Verification §2.3). Per scenario: accepted metrics + optional threshold overrides (a loosened threshold REQUIRES a rationale). A missing scenario recording or an unrecorded scenario fails the gate.

happy-path-loop.rationale: Single loop SSE stream with sequential lifecycle events: events/keys is high by construction (one key, many ordered events) — this is not over-broadcast, so the single-key fanout ceiling does not apply.

channel-ingestion-flood.rationale: Flood scenario deliberately replays duplicate item_ids and 2 channels to exercise inbox dedup + multi-channel fanout; dup-rate/fanout above the single-stream default is the point of the fixture.

workflow-journal-projection.rationale: A single workflow run's journal folded into its per-run SSE projection (key workflow:<id>): one key, many sequential lifecycle events, so events/keys is high by construction — not over-broadcast. The 'fold' block pins the event-fold law's terminal state (WF2-R11): a journal/projection format change that breaks the fold changes this dict and fails the compare (Success Criterion #4). This is the pre-migration gate on the journal format.

rewind-during-stream.rationale: A rewind lands mid-stream (epoch 0 -> 1) and a stale epoch-0 node_done arrives AFTER the epoch bump. The fold's epoch supersede-drop guard must drop it: 'dropped':1 and terminal 'epoch':1 are the proof the guard fired (WF2-R11). Single-key fanout is high by construction (one run, many ordered events), same rationale as the journal-projection scenario.
